title: Moltworker: It lets you Run Moltbot personal AI assistant in a Cloudflare Sandbox
description:
Cloudflare dropped this repo: Moltworker. It lets you Run Moltbot personal AI assistant in a Cloudflare Sandbox. No more renting a VPS, no more exposing open ports to hackers. It uses Cloudflare Workers for logic, R2 for memory, and Zero Trust for security. Works with Telegram, Discord, Slack—basically every chat platform. Cold starts take 1-2 minutes but then it stays alive indefinitely on the free tier.

https://github.com/cloudflare/moltworker

#github #opensource
